newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pohjola up on restructuring news.
newsitem.headline: Pohjola up on restructuring news.

text.p: Shares in Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola rose sharply in early trade after it announced a plan to restructure its life-insurance portfolio, brokers said.
At 1045/0845 GMT Pohjola liquid B share traded at 126.00 markka, up 7.70 markka or more than six percent, in fair six million markka trade.
"At least the early feeling is that investors see this as positive," one broker said. Pohjola's less liquid A share also picked up fast, trading at 125.00 markka, up 6.50 or more than five percent.
